chapter_seo_title: Chapter 402: The Name of the Zuowandao's Siming - Doumu Taiyin Revealed
chapter_meta_description: Zhuge Yuan reveals the name of the Zuowandao's patron deity and explains why a Heart-Element is their natural predator. A sudden fight pulls them into a reunion with a National Hand.
og_title: The Name of the Great Liar: Doumu Taiyin
og_description: Zhuge Yuan explains the source of the Zuowandao's power and Li Huowang discovers he could be their perfect counter—if he can learn to Cultivate the True.
twitter_title: The Zuowandao's god finally has a name: Doumu Taiyin
twitter_description: Noodles, poison tests, and a surprise reunion. New chapter drops a massive lore bomb about the source of the Zuowandao's power.

lore_anchors.definition: The Siming governing the domain of falsehood or shadow, worshipped by the Zuowandao. The name merges the Daoist Mother of the Dipper (Doumu) with the lunar Great Yin (Taiyin).
An informal but prestigious honorific, "Guo Shou" (国手), for the most skilled Go player in a nation, comparable to a grandmaster.
A supernatural ability granting enhanced hearing; used by Li Huowang to detect distant combat.
A corrupting military-sect blade carried by Li Huowang.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the significance of Doumu Taiyin?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is the specific, named Siming of the Zuowandao, confirming their divine power source is a real entity rather than mere trickery.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is Li Huowang considered a natural enemy of the Zuowandao?
cultural_notes_faq.a: As a Heart-Element, if he learns the method of Cultivating the True, he would be the conceptual opposite of their Cultivating the False, allowing him to counter their abilities.
A high-ranking Go player and a trusted old friend of Zhuge Yuan who serves in the Supervisory Heavenly Office.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Li Huowang feed the noodles to his dog first?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He uses Mantou as a live poison tester before eating himself, a grimly practical survival tactic.
